title: HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. translated_title: HME-PFD：异构专家混合特权特征蒸馏
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）被广泛用于将大型教师模型的知识迁移到较小的学生模型中，从而促进机器学习系统的高效服务。在广告推荐场景中，特权特征蒸馏（PFD）扩展了知识蒸馏，允许教师模型利用特权特征（即仅在训练阶段可用的特征）来提升蒸馏性能。然而，在现实场景中，特权特征往往覆盖率有限且呈现异构分布，导致不同训练样本对蒸馏和模型学习的重要性各不相同。我们提出了异构专家混合特权特征蒸馏（HME-PFD），这是一种新颖的方法，将特权特征融入到基于专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）的学生模型的路由模块中。我们的方法同时引入了硬编码和可学习的路由模块，使学生模型能够动态确定……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HME-PFD方法，通过在专家混合学生模型的路由模块中引入硬编码与可学习两种路由机制来融合特权特征，从而动态应对特权特征覆盖率有限且分布异构的问题，提升广告推荐场景下的蒸馏效果。
en_tdlr: HME-PFD incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model with both hard-coded and learnable routing, enabling dynamic handling of the limited coverage and heterogeneous distribution of privileged features for improved distillation in ads recommendation.
